brain MRI with contrast: 1.5T with gadolinium - frontal-predominant atrophy but NO focal lesion, with normal basal ganglia structure and volume
2. Genetic testing for Huntington's disease (CAG trinucleotide repeat)
HTT CAG repeat testing (Huntington disease): normal repeat length
Huntington HTT CAG repeat testing: normal repeat length
3. Serum ceruloplasmin and copper studies
24-hour urinary copper: normal
copper / caeruloplasmin: normal
4. Complete metabolic panel including liver and thyroid function
serum electrolytes, urea and creatinine: normal
liver function tests: normal
thyroid function (TSH, free T4): normal
5. Anti-NMDA receptor antibodies
serum paraneoplastic / neuronal autoantibody panel: negative
CSF autoimmune encephalitis panel: negative
autoimmune encephalopathy / paraneoplastic antibody panel: NEGATIVE in serum and CSF - seronegative
6. Neuropsychological testing
mental status / cognitive screen: progressive disorientation, tangential speech, grandiose hallucinations and euphoric affect
cognitive and behavioural assessment (MMSE / FAB): progressive disorientation, tangential speech, grandiose hallucinations and euphoric affect
7. CT chest/abdomen/pelvis
CT chest, abdomen and pelvis: no malignancy or infection
